scope: Accept an ODA-defined relative soft-pointer encoding for the VPORT control field only when its existing parser route marks the field as offset-resolved. Preserve the raw role span and keep strict output refusal for unrelated incomplete semantics.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

sections.2.13: Codes 0x6, 0x8, 0xA and 0xC encode relative offsets and always represent soft pointers; code 0xC subtracts the stored offset from the reference handle.
sections.20.4.64: A VPORT object's control reference is a soft pointer.

source.creation: Generated from scratch; not committed as a fixture.

implementation.behavior: The VPORT handle-role validator now accepts raw codes 0x06, 0x08, 0x0A and 0x0C only when the field is offset-resolved and expects the soft-pointer role. It retains the raw code in the handle span. Other field roles and non-offset fields keep exact-role checks.
testCoverage: Generated VPORT profiles retain exact spans, following sentinel and canonical roles across AC1012/AC1014/AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024/AC1027.
Generated AC1012 code-0x0C relative control resolves handle 0x09 minus one to VPORT_CONTROL handle 0x08 and retains raw code 0x0C.
An underflowing relative offset is rejected without publishing partial typed state; the complete code-0x0C input then succeeds on the same parser.

physicalProbe.observed: operationSucceeded=true; all 29 observed source frames published; zero entity/object parse failures. Strict DXF output still refuses because the generated file's current DIMSTYLE reference is null/unqualified.

limitations: Only the observed code-0x0C AC1012 VPORT-control case was exercised with a physical generated DWG; the other relative soft-pointer codes are covered by the normative rule and bounded parser predicate, not by separate physical producer witnesses.
The AC1012 source is a minimal locally generated drawing, not a producer-authored interoperability witness.
AC1012 strict output remains blocked by an unrelated null current DIMSTYLE reference; this fix does not promote whole-file support.
